04/09.05.2025: Heard the parties.

This anticipatory bail application under Sections 482 and 484 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, has been preferred by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 998 of 2023, for offences under Sections 323, 498A IPC and Section 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending before the Court of learned J.M. 1st Class, Rajmahal. .
Learned A.P.P. representing the State and counsel for the opposite party No. 2 oppose the anticipatory bail application vehemently.
Admitted fact is that the case arises out of a complaint.
Cognizance has been taken in this case and summon has been issued.
Thus, no useful purpose would be served to keep the petitioner behind bars.
Also, in a complaint case, there is no question of custodial interrogation.
The only fact which the Court has to be assured of is whether the accused will face the trial or not or whether there is any chance of tampering with the evidence.
